land.text: the union's Norway, which Karl Knutsson of Sweden had held 1449-1450

predecessors.note: Not a break in the state: 'Count Christian of Oldenburg was elected King of Denmark in 1448, of Norway in 1450, and of Sweden in 1457' - a dynasty change inside the Kalmar Union's realm (a rename event in the kalmar-union dossier, 1 September 1448).

land.text: the whole realm of Christian I once he is king of Sweden as well

successors.note: Sweden joined on 23 June 1457 (infobox of the Christian I page); Cliopatria's Oldenburg row ends in 1458 and the Kalmar Union row alone draws the realm from 1459.

capitals.name: Copenhagen (København)
capitals.note: Christian I's coronation as king of Denmark followed in Copenhagen on 28 October 1449; the page names no capital.

rulers.name: Christian I
rulers.title: king of Denmark (1448), Norway (1450) and Sweden (1457)
rulers.note: Reigned in Denmark 1448-1481; the row ends in 1458 but his rule does not.

correction.text: none: the lands are drawn under kalmar-union_1450 (Denmark, Norway, Iceland, the Faroes, Orkney, Shetland)

keyframe_review.note: 1,181,117 km2: Norway, Iceland, the Faroes, Orkney and Shetland (right for Christian I from his coronation at Trondheim on 2 August 1450) together with Sweden and Finland (2,305 of 2,440 and 1,423 of 1,695 cells), which are wrong: 'Sweden elected Karl Knutsson Bonde on 20 June 1448' and he was driven into exile only in 1457. The Norwegian part is drawn in the corrected Kalmar Union keyframe kalmar-union_1450, one realm and one colour for the Oldenburg kings (rule 2), so this row has no territory of its own.

correction.text: none: Sweden and Finland are Karl Knutsson's until June 1457, then drawn under kalmar-union_1457

keyframe_review.note: 443,849 km2: Sweden proper and southern Finland (1,146 and 1,050 cells). They were Karl Knutsson's until 1457: he 'was driven into exile in 1457' and Christian I's Swedish reign began on 23 June 1457 (coronation at Uppsala on 29 June). From then the realm is drawn under kalmar-union_1457; for 1453-1456 the land is Sweden's own (the Kingdom of Sweden dossier).

region.text: Trondheim, where Christian was crowned king of Norway

ledger.note: 2 August 1450: Christian I of Oldenburg is crowned king of Norway at Trondheim. 'Christian was crowned king of Norway in Trondheim on 2 August 1450' after Karl Knutsson was forced in June 1450 to renounce Norway; he had been elected king of Denmark at Viborg on 1 September 1448. The House of Oldenburg page: 'elected King of Denmark in 1448, of Norway in 1450, and of Sweden in 1457'.

region.text: the whole realm of Christian I as king of Denmark, Norway and Sweden

ledger.note: 1458: the Oldenburg row ends and the three crowns are one realm again. Christian I was king of Sweden from 23 June 1457 (infobox), so Denmark, Norway and Sweden are united under the Oldenburg king; the pages opened give no event dated 1458, so the year is Cliopatria's.

wars.name: Contest for Norway between Christian I and Karl Knutsson
wars.outcome: Karl was crowned at Trondheim on 20 November 1449 and forced to renounce Norway in June 1450; Christian was crowned there on 2 August 1450.
wars.note: Listed in the kalmar-union dossier as well; this row's only dated event. Reviewer 2026-10-25: 'from' set to 1450, this row's start; the contest began in February 1449.

certainty.note: The row carries no territory; the realm's frontiers are those of the Kalmar Union, approximate in the north.

sources.title: Christian I of Denmark
sources.note: 1448 election, 1450 coronation at Trondheim, 1457 Sweden, Karl Knutsson's dates.

sources.title: House of Oldenburg
sources.note: 'elected King of Denmark in 1448, of Norway in 1450, and of Sweden in 1457'; Danish kings 1448-1863; no area, no dissolution date for the House.

notes: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-25 (author, on review): this row is merged into kalmar-union (that dossier now lists 'House of Oldenburg' in cliopatria_names and carries both shape verdicts below as house-of-oldenburg_1450 and _1453). The review failed this file as a dynasty that merely succeeds on the same land; the withdrawal (deleting this file) is the orchestrator's call and the author's delete was not permitted, so the file remains. It should be deleted; while it stays, treat kalmar-union as the owner of these shapes. Not a separate state: Cliopatria's 'House of Oldenburg' (1450-1458) and 'Kalmar Union' rows share the Seshat polity sv_kalmar_union and describe one realm under one king, Christian I. By master-plan rule 2 a dynasty change inside a state is a rename (recorded in the kalmar-union dossier on 1 September 1448) and the colour stays; both shapes are therefore marked wrong with an empty correction, and the corrected territory (Denmark, Norway and dependencies 1450-1456, the whole realm from 23 June 1457) is in kalmar-union_1450, _1453 and _1457. If the rendering agent prefers a separate dynasty colour, this dossier's lands would be Norway 1450-1456 and the Swedish realm 1457-1458, but then the Kalmar keyframes would have to drop them. Cliopatria's two rows split the realm oddly: in 1450-1452 Kalmar Union is Denmark alone and Oldenburg is Norway plus (wrongly) Sweden and Finland; in 1453-1458 Kalmar is Denmark, Norway, Iceland and the north, and Oldenburg is Sweden proper and southern Finland. Pages: 2 opened (the Christian I page is shared with the Kalmar Union dossier). The House of Oldenburg page has no area; it lists the Danish kings 1448-1863. No ruler list beyond Christian I was needed. The 1458 end is Cliopatria's, page silent (confidence 1).
